## Summary

Describe the change and its user-visible effect.

## Validation

- [ ] `./scripts/format.sh` was run when formatting changed.
- [ ] `./scripts/check.sh` passes.
- [ ] `./scripts/check_all.sh` passes when documentation changed.
- [ ] Tests were added or updated for changed behavior.
- [ ] Documentation and `docs/changelog.md` were updated when needed.

## Checklist

- [ ] Public API changes use the `ranges` / `views` facade.
- [ ] No private implementation modules were added to the package root API.
- [ ] The change is focused and does not include unrelated cleanup.
